items.caption: What if you dropped Saturn in water? It would float: on average it's lighter than water for its size, under 700 g a litre (NASA). You'd just need a bathtub bigger than the planet. Photos: NASA/JPL/Space Science Institute (Cassini), NOAA Ocean Exploration.
